rationale: The bid-ask spread of 180 bps is extremely wide relative to the ATR of $0.14 on 5-minute bars, meaning the spread alone consumes multiple ATR units and makes any short-term trade structurally unprofitable before price even moves. Additionally, the stock has already gapped down 7% and is sitting near the top of today's range (78.8%) with the broader market under pressure (SPY -0.67%, VIXY +3.01%), creating an unfavorable risk/reward in either direction given the illiquidity and elevated volatility. With a working position already committed and the current spread/liquidity conditions, skipping preserves capital more effectively than forcing a trade.
